title: Paul's Thorn in the Flesh
description: Paul speaks of a thorn in the flesh given to him so that he would not become proud because of the overwhelming revelations he had received. Three times he pleaded with the Lord to take it away, but God answered that his grace is sufficient, for power is made perfect in weakness.
